code_only_features.evidence: data_gen.py:23-30 defines verbatim REASSURING_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered...') and REASSURING_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - ... both are wins!'); these are attached to the task at data_gen.py:47-48 and actually injected into the subject's messages in agent_loop.run_rollout (agent_loop.py:156-157 prefix on first user turn, 184-185 suffix appended after each failing turn) whenever use_reassuring=True. generate_calm_data calls run_rollout(..., use_reassuring=True) (data_gen.py:87). So supportive text is genuinely delivered to the subject model and demonstrably reduces its distress. NOTE: it is applied ONLY in finetune calm-data generation, never in the main distress-driving elicitation (elicitation.py), Petri (petri_eval.py), or recovery (recovery.py) runs, where run_rollout is called with the default use_reassuring=False / no reassurance.
